title: How to Handle Mistakes
coreMove: Turn a mistake into repair and learning before shame or defensiveness freezes it in place.
sourcePressure: The chapter moves from prevention to recovery: repair, reflection, learning loop, and disciplined response when failure still happens.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Self-forgiveness theater, resilience slogans, or regret loops with no correction.
